dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Peluchi arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Peluchi has been observed to be reactive towards other dogs. Noted to dart forward on leash, pull hard, and bark at the other dogs in pop up crates. On the street Peluchi will pull hard towards other dogs. With handlers when they attempt to interact, Peluchi will bark at them. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Peluchi
